step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding.

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 6.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li:
Issue: Select the appropriate issue as follows:
If the disentitlement is 38 - On vacation in Canada , select Availability .
If the disentitlement is listed below, select Other .
33 - Incapacity proven but not otherwise available (D33).
34 - Parental benefits entitlement conditions no met (D34).
51 - Does not meet compassionate care entitlement conditions (D51).
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
